pool.baseline: i feel like my whole life belongs to everyone else. every decision, every move i make, it's all for my parents and what my community thinks of me. i don't even feel like a person anymore, just a vessel for their expectations. it's like i'm being suffocated by all these rules and traditions and i can't breathe. i just want to find a way to actually be mine. i just want to find some kind of real freedom that they can't touch or take away from me.
